# Bookstr

> A literary platform celebrating diverse voices, book culture, and author stories across multiple genres and communities.

Bookstr is a book-focused media site dedicated to amplifying underrepresented authors and fostering a vibrant reading community. The platform features author interviews, book recommendations, poetry, and literary news with a strong emphasis on Black voices, female authors, LGBTQIA writers, and diverse multicultural perspectives.

## Key Topics

- Diverse voices
- Author interviews
- Book culture
- Black voices
- Female authors
- LGBTQIA reads
- Debut authors
- Poetry collections
- Book recommendations
- Reading community
- Author features
- Literary news
- Native American Heritage
- Indie booksellers
- Book adaptations

## Diverse Voices & Author Representation

- [Author's Corner](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner): Author's Corner hub with diverse author features, news, and literary tributes.
- [Black Voices](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/black-voices): Black Voices category featuring diverse Black authors and representation.
- [Female Voices](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/female-voices): Female Voices category highlighting women writers and literary analysis.
- [LGBTQ Voices](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/lgbtq-voices): LGBTQ Voices category showcasing LGBTQIA literature and diverse authors.
- [Diverse Voices](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/diverse-voices): Diverse Voices category featuring Native American and multicultural authors.

## Author Interviews & Profiles

- [Author Interviews](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/author-interviews): Author Interviews featuring debut and established diverse authors.
- [Featured Authors](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/featured-authors): Featured Authors spotlight with interviews and author profiles.
- [5×5 Authors Corner](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/5x5-authors-corner): 5×5 author interview series exploring diverse voices across genres.
- [Bookstr Talks](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/bookstr-talks-authors-corner): Bookstr Talks author interview series with literary discussion guides.
- [Upcoming Authors](https://archive.bookstr.com/authors-corner/upcoming-authors): Upcoming Authors featuring debut authors and literary events.

## Book Culture & Literary Content

- [Book Culture](https://archive.bookstr.com/book-culture): Book Culture hub covering poetry, adaptations, and reading community.
- [Opinions](https://archive.bookstr.com/book-culture/opinions): Opinions on literary tropes, writing prompts, and fandom discussion.
- [On This Day](https://archive.bookstr.com/book-culture/on-this-day): On This Day featuring literary anniversaries and author birthdays.
- [Bookspot & Libraries](https://archive.bookstr.com/book-culture/bookspot-and-libraries): Bookspot and Libraries featuring indie booksellers and reading programs.

## Home & Main Hub

- [Bookstr Homepage](https://archive.bookstr.com): Bookstr homepage featuring book recommendations, poetry, and literary news.
